rv.q: Camping is their tragedy, a shattering off-Broadway debut from a playwright to watch.
This is the first professional production of playwright Victoria Lynne Barclay, and it is a strong start out of the gate.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate two-woman drama that traces a decades-long friendship from age 15 to 40, all within the confines of a tent. The inventive setting proves surprisingly expansive for exploring complex themes of loyalty, sexuality, and female bonds.
